physical_object_motion: Native checkpoint initialization, then native FEM/contact only

physics.solver: Genesis 1.4.3 + libuipc 0.0.29, IPC contact, FEM shell/volume

native_floor.scope: Initial native plane point only, before World.init

physics.grasp_model: finite-force finger PD and IPC friction, no ideal attachment
physics.rigid_contact_solver: Genesis rigid solver with scene-local restoration of IPC-delegated collision pairs
physics.soft_environment_contact: tabletop, legs, mounts and floor participate in native IPC contact
physics.bear_material_scope: homogeneous compressible elastic filling approximation; no separate textile skin
physics.bag_material_scope: Isotropic kraft-paper elastic shell with connected rectangular sides, bottom and handles; uncalibrated; no permanent creases or tearing
physics.handle_material_scope: Paper ribbon handles, same material and thickness as body
physics.cloth_thickness_convention: IPC thickness is a radius; physical thickness is twice the configured value

material_readback.material: uncalibrated effective isotropic elastic approximation to dry kraft paper
material_readback.scope: Scene-local native constitution selection before IPC World initialization
material_readback.calibration_status: Engineering assumptions; reference photo provides no measured material parameters
material_readback.rest_shape: Manufactured open rectangular form; existing folds belong to initial rest geometry
material_readback.handles: Same shell material as bag body; flat paper strip approximation, not twisted cord
limitations: Uncalibrated effective isotropic paper; no orthotropic fibre directions, yielding, tearing or new permanent creases
No moisture dependence, viscoelastic relaxation, calibrated damping, glue delamination or air pressure
2D isotropic neo-Hookean law matches small-strain plane stress; finite-strain 3D plane-stress reduction is not solved

initialization.method: Actual qpos after rigid solver build, before IPC geometry build

native_solver.scope: One native configuration attribute before World.init
native_solver.interpretation: MAS preconditions all nonempty FEM bodies; setup and application overhead can outweigh reduced PCG iterations

rigid_contact.method: Scene-local Collider subclass; original Genesis pair filters with temporary delegation tags hidden

limitations: Rigid FK flags inferred from completed Genesis IPC rigid-post-coupling substep; not exported originally
No resumed-step equivalence comparison against the original uninterrupted process
Python task/controller objects and unexported caches are not restored by this helper

fk_flags.source: inferred from Genesis rigid_solver.substep final assignment

restoration.static_config_source: Fresh identical-config scene; original static objects were exported only as repr

release_exception.scope: User requested direct release without further quality testing

latest_checkpoint.label: finish

rigid_solver.scope: Installed solver checkpoint arrays; includes available declared state/scratch buffers, not a whole-scene resume certificate

native_observation_verification.coordinate_conversion: physics = canonical - origin; only roundoff tolerance allowed

limitations: No restoration or resumed-step equivalence test was performed.
Native dump + robot/controller/coupling observations are preservation evidence, not a certified exact restart.
Undeclared native/Genesis caches, callbacks, sensor state and Python controller state may remain unexported.
Archived inputs support replay from the initial state; replay is distinct from resuming this midpoint.

actual_containment.method: Solid-angle winding of actual deformed bag body plus a diagnostic centroid-fan mouth cap
limitations: The virtual mouth cap is an analysis surface; it adds no collision, support, or force to the bag.
Small rim warping uses the actual piecewise fan; warping beyond tolerance, self-crossing rims, and non-star-shaped fans are rejected.
All sampled vertices inside does not prove every teddy edge/face stays inside a folded or concave bag.
Topological watertightness is not a geometric self-intersection test; native collision validity must be independently checked.
This single-frame enclosure test does not prove grasp correctness, upright placement, release, or stability.

final_bag_pose.method: Proper least-squares rigid fit of bag body vertices; deformation is reported as residual.

runtime.method: Read-only native frame statistics/status and CUDA allocator counters

initial_cuda.scope: Device-wide free/total plus this process's PyTorch allocator; IPC and graphics allocations are outside PyTorch counters

runtime.convergence_policy: Require completed, converged, no Newton-limit and no engine errors every step. Record sticky line-search-limit separately: it can occur in an intermediate Newton iteration that subsequently converges. Such warnings are not a claim of exact energy descent.
limitations: Native convergence covers each distinct step where sample() is called; invoke it after every step for complete coverage
scene_step timing excludes observations, camera rendering, video encoding and motion planning
CUDA allocator queries do not measure GPU utilization or attribute device-wide memory to this process

public_copy_note: Summary copy; full original report and all sampled records are in the release archive.
